title: This is How We Help You Implement AI
subtitle: We guide you on a clear and structured journey. We start with strategy, move on to technical implementation, and culminate with the transformation of your Business.

step1.title: Step 1: Clarity and Strategy
step1.description: To master AI, you first need a plan. This phase is dedicated to giving you total clarity: from understanding the potential and defining where to start, to having the complete strategic roadmap to implement AI in your company with a long-term vision.

step2.title: Step 2: Technical Implementation
step2.description: From strategy to reality. This is where we "roll up our sleeves" to build and implement AI tools, automations, and agents efficiently, stably, and scalably over time, so your team can start reaping the benefits of efficiency.

step3.title: Step 3: Organizational Transformation
step3.description: When implementing AI automations and agents, your business is no longer the same. It's faster, smarter, and more capable. This new reality makes it natural and necessary to transform your operational, organizational, commercial, and business model to capitalize on all that potential. In this phase, we help you build the future of your company, both at the organizational and commercial level.

tab1.name: Opportunities Report
tab1.title: AI Opportunities Report
tab1.description: Request your personalized report and schedule a Discovery Session that will give you a starting point to visualize the potential of AI in your company.
tab1.idealFor: you want to gain clarity and understand more about how Companies are adopting AI. You'll get insight into your industry and the size of the opportunity for your business.

includes.title: What does the Opportunities Report include?

items.text: AI Maturity Level: Your result. (Based on Google's AI Adoption Framework)
Recommendations: Next steps according to your business maturity level.
Top 3 Opportunity Areas: Pain Points in your business that could be resolved with AI.
Appendix: Analysis of the AI opportunity for Business.

tab2.name: Efficiency Audit
tab2.title: Efficiency Audit
tab2.description: We find and prioritize quick-wins with the highest ROI to take advantage of TODAY's most attractive opportunities for your business.
tab2.idealFor: the free report opened your eyes and now you need to know exactly where to start with concrete actions and a clear ROI.

items.text: Mapping Sessions: Interviews with your team in key areas of your business.
Tactical Action Plan: Deliverable with tools, automations, or AI agents to implement in a prioritized manner.
ROI Analysis: Estimation of savings or Return on Investment.

tab3.name: Strategic Plan
tab3.title: Strategic Plan
tab3.description: We design the implementation plan for AI, Agents, and Automations, so you can evolve sustainably thanks to AI.
tab3.idealFor: you're ready to go beyond quick-wins and need the complete strategic map to build your AI unit in a structured way.

items.text: Strategic Workshop: Intensive session.
Adoption Roadmap: Internal implementation timeline.
AI Architecture: Design of your company's AI management system.

onboarding.title: Strategic Onboarding Offer
onboarding.description: Ready for a subscription plan? Sign up for the Impulse or Scale Plan and get our Audit + Strategic Plan for a DISCOUNTED one-time payment.
onboarding.note: Save almost 60% and start with a solid strategic foundation from day one.

tab1.name: Custom Solutions
tab1.title: Custom Solutions
tab1.description: For specific needs. We develop custom tools, automations, or AI agents, with total flexibility for your business.
tab1.idealFor: you have a very specific need that doesn't fit into a standard plan and you're looking for maximum flexibility in the development and ownership of the solution.

includes.title: Maximum Flexibility
items: Custom development: We create the exact solution you need.
Management and Maintenance: Can be handled by us or by you.
Hosting: In our environments or in yours.
Intellectual Property: The source code, documentation, credentials, and copyright can be yours or ours.

tab2.name: Impulse Plan
tab2.title: IMPULSE Plan
tab2.description: The fastest way to get started. We do it for you on our infrastructure. Ideal for getting results without technical management. Source code is not delivered.
tab2.idealFor: you're looking for the fastest way to get results and completely delegate technical management, without worrying about infrastructure.

includes.title: What do you receive with this subscription?

sections.title: Conditions:
items: The result of the automation is delivered (E.g., content for posts) not the source code.
Hosting, credentials, source code, and associated maintenance are handled by us.
Additional setup (not included in the plan) of automation is charged $$.

tab3.name: Scale Plan
tab3.title: SCALE Plan
tab3.price: Payment (Setup) + Payment / month
tab3.description: We do it for you: we create the automation environment, manage and maintain it but in your own infrastructure. The hosting, source code, credentials, tools, and copyright are 100% yours.
tab3.idealFor: you want to own the code and AI assets, having maximum control to scale and build a long-term competitive advantage.

includes.title: What do you receive with this subscription?

sections.title: Conditions:
items: Hosting, credentials, source code, and tools belong to the agency.
Solution documentation is delivered, and a handover session is conducted.
The automation environment is maintained and managed, as well as AI Agents and Automations.
Additional setup (not included in the plan) of automation will be charged $$.

tab1.name: Exponential Diagnosis
tab1.title: Exponential Diagnosis
tab1.description: The first step for any real transformation. This diagnosis analyzes your company in depth from the perspective of an Exponential Organization, allowing you to clearly see what is working, what is blocking your growth, and what areas you can activate to scale.
tab1.idealFor: you feel you're not leveraging the potential of your business and need an external and expert vision to identify the organizational blocks that prevent your evolution.

items.text: ExO Organizational Maturity Assessment
Analysis of existing AI initiatives and their organizational impact
Identification of structural and cultural blocks
Strategic report with key recommendations

tab2.name: Organizational Redesign
tab2.title: Purpose and Organizational Redesign
tab2.description: Your company is no longer the same after AI. In this service, we redefine your transformative purpose with you and design a new organizational structure based on ExO principles. A business prepared to scale sustainably needs a clear, distributed model aligned with its new reality.
tab2.idealFor: you already know you need to change, but you lack the structure and purpose to align your team and redesign your organization for the future.

items.text: MTP (Massive Transformative Purpose) definition workshop
Strategic declaration of purpose and vision
Design of new organizational model adapted to the ExO framework
Priority ExO attributes to scale your agency

tab3.name: Roadmap
tab3.title: Roadmap
tab3.description: We design the complete organizational transformation plan, with a detailed implementation timeline, so you can evolve sustainably thanks to AI.
tab3.idealFor: you're ready to go beyond quick-wins and need the complete strategic map to transform your company in a structured way.

items.text: Strategic Workshop: Intensive session
Transformation Roadmap: Implementation timeline
Organizational Architecture: Management system design

tab4.name: Accompaniment
tab4.title: Accompaniment
tab4.description: We accompany you in the implementation of organizational transformation, with follow-up and adjustment sessions, to ensure that the evolution is carried out correctly and sustainably.
tab4.idealFor: you understand that the transformation is human and value the expert support to ensure the organizational changes and transformation are sustainable in the long term.

items.text: Regular follow-up sessions
Adjustments and corrections in implementation
Team training and capacity building

callToAction.heading: YOU'RE JUST A FEW STEPS AWAY FROM GAINING CLARITY
callToAction.title: Shall we start with the easiest part?
callToAction.description: We don't sell anything without first understanding if we can help you. The Discovery Session is completely free and without commitment. Only if there's a fit, we continue.
